newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Vakif real estate trust to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Vakif real estate trust to float shares.

text.p: Vakif real estate investment trust, owned 55 percent by Turkish state bank T.Vakiflar Bankasi will float its 250 billion lira nominal-valued shares, or 50 percent of its capital on December 24-26.
Offer manager Vakiflar Bankasi said in a statement that the offer price per 1,000 lira share would be fixed at 2,000 lira.
The trust holds a portfolio which consists of capital market tools based on real-estate development, building and land projects and real estate investments made to earn rent.

Last week, Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK) approved the trust's capital increase to 500 billion lira from 250 billion lira by issuing 250 billion lira of rights which will be waived to be offered to the public.
